source.quote: The registrant had 7,933,746,241 shares of common stock outstanding as of August 26, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as WMT since December 9, 2025 (previously NYSE). The 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (filed August 28, 2026) is the latest filed count; the third-quarter 10-Q had not been filed by November 24, 2026.
